public_copy.root: Planning a hospital visit in Shanghai? The city’s guide lists email booking at Zhongshan Hospital and services in English, French and Japanese. Ask which language is available for your visit before booking travel. https://english.shanghai.gov.cn/en-FindaHospital/20241014/b2c233212540411bbda89575cbd5d608.html
public_copy.video: Three questions to ask before a hospital visit in Shanghai: Can I book by email? Is my language available on that date? Who can confirm the cost in writing? Which city should our next guide cover?
public_copy.alt: Shanghai service guide. The city lists email reservations at Zhongshan Hospital. Ask about language availability before booking travel.
